stories.title: Mold, Deeside, Flint and Holywell to host bus network consultation events
stories.summary: Four public drop-in events on the future of bus services in Flintshire will be held in Mold, Deeside, Flint and Holywell in September. stories.title: Callers told a grieving north Wales family their dead relative had left £300,000 in crypto
stories.summary: North Wales Police have warned that fraudsters are targeting families after a death by claiming their relative left behind a cryptocurrency fortune.
